name: melopop
description: Mélo Pop — jeu de match-3 musical (Capacitor + AdMob)

scripts.add:android: npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-admob.mjs
scripts.add:ios: npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-admob.mjs

scripts.ios: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
